flow.dashboard.v2.DashboardTask.description:
DashboardTask is the compact task shape the dashboard's my-tasks widget
renders. v1 reused the fat Task message from the task domain; with both
task.v1 and task.v2 in circulation a plain-name reference became ambiguous,
and the dashboard never needed most of those fields anyway. Deliberately
local to this package.

assignee_initials.description: assignee_initials are two-letter uppercase initials. Empty if unassigned.

assignee_name.description: assignee_name is the assignee display name. Empty if unassigned.

due_date.description: due_date is the due date value for this contract.

id.description: id is the unique identifier for the resource.

priority.description: priority is the priority value for this contract.

project_color.description: project_color is the project color hex for inline badges.

project_name.description: project_name is the denormalised project display name.

status.description: status is the current lifecycle state.

title.description: title is the title value for this contract.

completed_this_week.description: completed_this_week is the completed this week value for this contract.

in_progress_tasks.description: in_progress_tasks is the in progress tasks value for this contract.

my_tasks.description:
my_tasks lists tasks assigned to the caller across their visible
projects. With workspaces gone there is exactly one scope, so v1's
workspace-scoped my-tasks concern dissolves.

open_tasks.description: open_tasks is the open tasks value for this contract.

overdue_tasks.description: overdue_tasks is the overdue tasks value for this contract.
